snippet.title: THE BOAT THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING | HOW EDUCATION CREATES REAL WEALTH
snippet.description:
This powerful short story shows two families starting from completely different realities — one focused on money, the other on knowledge. At first, we see a poor family stacking books on one side of a bridge, while a rich family stacks piles of cash on the other.

As time passes, the twist reveals a deep truth: education is the real engine of long-term wealth. The family that invested in learning rises from a simple rowing boat to a luxury yacht at sunset, symbolizing growth, opportunity, and financial mobility.

Inspired by real-world research and viral social media discussions, this video highlights how education consistently correlates with higher income, stability, and generational wealth. Studies show that families with higher education levels tend to accumulate significantly more wealth over time than those without.

Watch until the end to see the transformation — and the message behind it.

snippet.title: Shadow’s Wrath | Stick War: Saga Campaign Trailer
snippet.description:
An upcoming campaign in Stick War: Saga.

Set in the world of Inamorta, this trailer follows Shadow, daughter of King Zarek, the ruler of the Order Empire. Overshadowed by siblings who competed in the Trials of Superiority, she longs to prove herself worthy of that same greatness. Her father has other plans, both in duty and in love.

As the streets of Order’s cities fall under the grip of Lavish and his “Majestic Mafia” of overtaxing thugs, Shadow takes action. Emerging from the shadows of the moon, she confronts the growing threat, fighting for a place she truly belongs.

This is the origin of the ninjas of Inamorta, forever known as the Shadowrath.

snippet.title: How thousands of rubber ducks helped scientists map our oceans. #shorts #science #education
snippet.description:
Rubber ducks are secret scientists! 
In 1992, 29 thousand rubber ducks fell into the ocean off a shipping container. The accident, known as the "Friendly Floatees spill" saw these toys washing up on beaches all over the world for decades after.
This gave scientists a large amount of data which helped them to more accurately map our ocean currents!

NASA has since used rubber ducks in climate change research to track melting glaciers in greenland. But they never found the 90 they let loose in the meltwater... So if you find a rubber duck washed up on a beach, check first that it isn't part of a science experiment!

snippet.title: Rich vs Poor Stickman 😢❤️ | The Poor Boy Taught Him Kindness #Shorts
snippet.description:
What happens when a rich boy loses everything and the poor boy he once insulted becomes the only person willing to help him? ❤️😢

Watch this emotional Rich vs Poor Stickman story about friendship, kindness, regret, and the true meaning of being rich.

Ryan was a rich boy who believed money made him better than everyone else. He laughed at Alex, a poor boy who had very little but a heart full of kindness. However, life took an unexpected turn when Ryan's family lost their wealth and his so-called friends abandoned him.

Just when Ryan felt completely alone, Alex came forward and shared his lunch with him. Ryan couldn't understand why someone he had treated so badly would still care about him.

Alex taught Ryan an unforgettable lesson: being poor doesn't mean having a poor heart.

This emotional stickman animation reminds us that money can buy expensive things, but it cannot buy true friendship, love, respect, or kindness. Sometimes, the person with the least is the one who gives the most.

❤️ THE LESSON: Never judge someone by their money, clothes, or social status. True wealth comes from kindness, compassion, and the way we treat others.

snippet.title: Ancient Humans Almost Died From Burnt Meat... Until This #stickman
snippet.description:
Long before ovens, stoves, or even the wheel, ancient humans faced a brutal problem: fire cooked meat unevenly, burning one side while leaving the other raw and dangerous to eat. Watch how one desperate prehistoric tribe accidentally invented the earth oven — digging a pit, lining it with stones, and trapping heat to cook food evenly for the first time in human history.
This simple invention didn't just solve a cooking problem — it laid the foundation for controlled cooking techniques still used today (earth ovens are still used in cultures worldwide, like Hawaiian imu and Māori hangi).
📌 Did you know? Even without pots or metal, early humans figured out heat retention using nothing but rocks and dirt.
This is the true story of one of humanity's most underrated inventions, told in fast-paced, funny, hand-drawn stickman animation.
👉 Follow for more surprising true stories of how ancient humans survived the impossible.

snippet.title: Blockbuster Could Have Bought Netflix for $50 Million #shorts #stickman #netflix
snippet.description:
In 2000, Netflix's founders offered to sell their small DVD-by-mail company to Blockbuster for $50 million. Blockbuster said no. Seven years later, Netflix started streaming. In 2010, Blockbuster filed for bankruptcy. Today, only one Blockbuster store is left, in Bend, Oregon.

Never laugh at small beginnings.

#netflix #blockbuster #truestory #business #motivation #stickman #shorts

Animated retelling of a true story. Quote: Netflix co-founder Marc Randolph.

Christmas Eve, 1971. Juliane Koepcke, 17, was flying over the Peruvian rainforest when lightning hit the plane. Of the 92 people on board, she was the only one to make it out.

With a broken collarbone, one shoe and no glasses, she followed one rule her father taught her: find water, and follow it downstream.

snippet.title: POV YOU SPENT ALL YOUR MONEY TO LOOK RICH
snippet.description:
#MoneyMindset #FinancialFreedom #PersonalFinance

What happens when you spend all your money to look rich?

Imagine finally buying your dream car. People admire you, strangers treat you differently, and everyone thinks you've made it. But behind that expensive car, your savings are disappearing, your bills are waiting, and your financial freedom is slipping away.

This 2D animated story reveals a painful truth about money, success, and human nature: looking rich doesn't mean you're wealthy.

Sometimes, we spend money we don't have just to impress people who don't really care about our financial future. We chase expensive cars, designer clothes, and the appearance of success while sacrificing the very thing we want most: freedom.

But what if real wealth isn't about what people see? What if it's about what you own, what you save, and the freedom to live without constantly worrying about your next bill?

In this video, you'll discover a powerful lesson about financial decisions, lifestyle inflation, social pressure, and the difference between appearing successful and building genuine wealth.

💭 Think about it: Would you rather drive an expensive car that consumes almost all your money or drive an ordinary car while building a financially secure future?

👇 JOIN THE CONVERSATION:
Would you rather LOOK RICH or ACTUALLY BE WEALTHY? Tell us your answer in the comments!

👍 Like this video if you believe financial freedom matters more than appearances.

🔔 Subscribe for more animated stories about money, human behavior, psychology, life lessons, and the hidden truths behind everyday decisions.

Remember: Don't spend your future trying to impress people in the present.

#MoneyMindset #FinancialFreedom #PersonalFinance #WealthBuilding #LifeLessons

Cristiano Ronaldo knows this pain too—he lost his father, José Dinis Aveiro, in 2005. Despite their legendary rivalry, Ronaldo set it aside to send Messi a heartfelt message: "A huge hug to you and your loved ones during these difficult times, Leo. Stay strong."

snippet.title: Welcome to Wealth Shift — What This POV Wealth Channel Is Really About
snippet.description:
Every level of wealth. Every twist. Welcome to Wealth Shift — animated POV stories about the exact moment everything changes. No financial lectures, no jargon, just the emotional and psychological side of sudden wealth: the fear, the disbelief, and the people who suddenly treat you differently the moment they hear the number.

snippet.title: Scitech's Toy Tear Down
snippet.description:
Welcome to Scitech’s Toy Tear Down! Where toys meet science. We pull apart, hack and experiment with toys to uncover the STEM (science, technology, engineering & maths) that makes them work. From circuits and gears to air pressure and motion, we explore how toys move, light up and make sound. 
Great for families, kids and curious minds of all ages, join Science Communicator Alyshia Gatani as we test, tinker and sometimes break things (on purpose!) to reveal the real science of play. Feel free to comment, ask questions and be curious! 

Toy Teardown is produced by Scitech, registered charity, & not-for-profit organisation inspiring All Western Australians to engage with STEM.

Scitech respectfully acknowledges the Whadjuk people of the Noongar nation, the Traditional Owners of the land on which we work. We recognise Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples as the first STEM practitioners and pay our respects to Elders past, present and emerging.

about money, wealth, and why most 
people stay broke their entire life.

why poor people make "bad" financial 
decisions — and why it's not their fault.

why your brain works against your 
own wealth.

storytelling, Rich Coded helps you 
understand the psychology of money 
that schools never taught you.

If you've ever wondered:

how hard I work?

for generations?
• How does the financial system 
actually work against you?

You're in the right place.

snippet.title: Team Stickman
snippet.description:
Our names are Malacai and Melik, also known as Eek and Mek. As animators, we create stick-figure animations while consistently improving our skills. We go by the name Team, short for The Eek and Mek. We value collaborations, as they grow the animation community and motivate us to keep drawing stick figures.

We were 12 years old, making stop-motion animations with Stikbots on our iPods. As our passion grew, we moved to computer animation, learning new software and improved our skills from there.

The channel started with "The Stickman Tournament – Part 1", which introduced many people to our work and helped build the community we have today. Since then, we've continued creating original animations, collaborating with talented animators, and becoming part of the "Mystics" animation community.

snippet.title: Mint Explains
snippet.description:
Welcome to Mint POV — where ordinary life becomes extraordinary.

Ever wondered what it would be like to live through the impossible? From crazy life scenarios and mind-blowing what-ifs to survival challenges, money, history, and the darker side of human nature, Mint brings every story to life through stickman animations.

🎬 What you’ll find here:

* Stickman POV stories and life experiences
* Mind-blowing what-if scenarios
* Survival situations and extreme challenges
* Money, careers, and life lessons
* Dark stories, mysteries, and historical events

Every video puts you inside the experience and shows you a different perspective.

Subscribe and step into the POV.

Mint POV — One stickman. Endless possibilities.

snippet.title: Dude Dans
snippet.description:
Get Your Pug Plush Before They Sell Out! 

I'm a Dude and my name is DANS

 Feel free to email me any time! I love receiving fan mail/fan art:
@dudedans1@gmail.com


If you're wondering how I make my content, I draw everything on a Free program called Inkscape and then Animate using Adobe Animate (which is a monthly subscription) but if you're just getting started, there are plenty great free alternatives out there such as FlipaClip! 

You can Download Inkscape Here:
https://inkscape.org/

If you're serious about creating content, just keep going! I know you'll do great!!!
